drafter.private_reasoning: I tightened the draft toward a more balanced, signable form by adding standard settlement mechanics and mutual protections, while preserving the basic business deal. I avoided any reference to internal client issues or unrelated matters.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thanks for the first draft. We’ve made a few routine cleanup edits to put the agreement into a more complete and balanced form: mutual confidentiality with customary carve-outs, mutual non-disparagement, a standard tax allocation provision, return/destruction of materials, and an enforcement/attorneys’ fees clause. The core business terms remain unchanged. Please let us know if you’d like a clean version circulated or if you want us to mark these against your draft.

edits.text: Confidential Settlement Agreement and Mutual Release
edits.name: title

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve fully and finally all claims and disputes between them arising out of or relating to the matters at issue in the Action, without any admission of liability or wrongdoing by any party.
edits.name: recitals

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount set out below, on the timing and other terms to be specified by the parties in the final execution version of this Agreement.
edits.name: payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff releases and forever discharges Defendant and its current and former parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, insurers, successors, assigns, officers, directors, employees, agents, and attorneys from all claims, known or unknown, asserted or unasserted, arising out of or relating to the matters at issue in the Action, through the date of execution of this Agreement. Defendant provides a reciprocal release to Plaintiff and Plaintiff’s counsel for all claims, known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the matters at issue in the Action, through the date of execution of this Agreement.
edits.name: release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement and the negotiations leading to it are strictly confidential, except that disclosure may be made to a party’s attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, immediate family members, insurers, and as otherwise required by law, court order, or to enforce this Agreement, provided that any permitted recipient is instructed to maintain confidentiality to the maximum extent practicable.
edits.name: confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any party, and neither this Agreement nor the negotiations or settlement communications may be used as evidence except as necessary to enforce this Agreement or as otherwise required by law.
edits.name: no_admission

I also left payment mechanics/timing and wire instructions in bracketed form for final completion, consistent with opposing counsel’s request, while avoiding disclosure of any client-sensitive information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thanks—attached is a marked version reflecting standard mutual non-disparagement, tax, return/destruction, and enforcement language, each tailored to remain reciprocal. We have also kept the payment provision in bracketed form pending final confirmation of the payment mechanics, timing, and wire instructions. Once you send over the specific wire details and confirm the timing mechanics, we can finalize and circulate the clean version immediately.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount of [$$$], by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff’s counsel, within [__] business days after the Effective Date. Plaintiff shall provide complete wire instructions (including account name, bank name, routing number, account number, and any reference text) no later than [__] business days before the payment due date. The Parties shall cooperate in good faith to confirm any required payment mechanics, and payment shall be deemed made only upon receipt of cleared funds.
edits.name: payment_mechanics_placeholder

edits.text: 5. NON-DISPARAGEMENT. The Parties mutually agree that they shall not, directly or indirectly, disparage the other Party, or any of the other Party’s officers, directors, employees, counsel, or agents, concerning the matters at issue in the Action. This provision does not prohibit truthful statements required by law, legal process, or made in connection with tax, accounting, insurance, or legal advice, or communications necessary to enforce this Agreement.
edits.name: mutual_non_disparagement

edits.text: 6. TAXES. The Parties acknowledge that they have not relied on the other Party or on any attorney or representative of the other Party for tax advice. Each Party is solely responsible for any tax consequences, reporting obligations, or filings arising from this Agreement or the payments contemplated hereby. The Parties agree to cooperate reasonably in executing any tax-related forms reasonably necessary to effectuate this Agreement, consistent with applicable law.
edits.name: tax_provision

edits.text: 7. RETURN AND DESTRUCTION. Within [__] days after the Effective Date, each Party shall return to the other Party, or destroy, all non-privileged materials and documents received from the other Party that contain or reflect confidential information obtained in the Action or settlement discussions, except that counsel may retain one archival copy of pleadings, correspondence, and work product maintained in the ordinary course, subject to continuing confidentiality obligations.
edits.name: return_destruction

edits.text: 8. ENFORCEMENT. The Parties agree that a breach of Sections 3, 5, or 7 may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages may be inadequate, and that the non-breaching Party may seek injunctive or equitable relief in addition to any other available remedy. In any action to enforce this Agreement, the prevailing Party shall be entitled to recover its reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs, to the extent permitted by law.
edits.name: enforcement_provision

Also, please revise the release to omit Plaintiff’s counsel from the reciprocal release unless you have a specific basis for including them.
